definitions.gloss: table salt; dietary salt; sodium chloride
definitions.explanation: Salt used for cooking and eating. Also used in scientific and health contexts to refer to sodium chloride. More formal or technical than the everyday word {塩|しお}.

examples.japanese: {食塩|しょくえん}の{取|と}りすぎに{注意|ちゅうい}しましょう。
examples.english: Let's be careful not to consume too much salt.

examples.japanese: この{食品|しょくひん}の{食塩|しょくえん}{相当量|そうとうりょう}は2グラムです。
examples.english: The salt equivalent in this food product is 2 grams.

examples.japanese: {日本人|にほんじん}の{一日|いちにち}あたりの{食塩|しょくえん}{摂取量|せっしゅりょう}は{世界的|せかいてき}に{見|み}ても{多|おお}いと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that the daily salt intake of Japanese people is high even by global standards.

notes:
Used in health, nutrition, and scientific contexts. In everyday cooking, {塩|しお} is the standard word. {食塩|しょくえん} appears on nutrition labels, in dietary guidelines, and in chemistry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食塩|しょくえん}{摂取量|せっしゅりょう} (salt intake)
- {食塩|しょくえん}{相当量|そうとうりょう} (salt equivalent — on nutrition labels)
- {食塩|しょくえん}{水|すい} (saline solution)
- {食塩|しょくえん}を{控|ひか}える (reduce salt intake)
- {無|む}{食塩|しょくえん} (salt-free)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {塩|しお} is the everyday word for salt
- {食塩|しょくえん} is used on labels, in health advice, and in chemistry
- {塩分|えんぶん} refers to salt content in food
